title: Manipulation testing based on Benford's Law for discrete scores
summary: This paper addresses the problem of running variable manipulation in Regression Discontinuity Designs. Leveraging the observation that manipulation often alters the density balance around the cutoff, we detect these structural imbalances using Benford's Law -a natural statistical regularity widely applied in fraud detection. Our framework serves as a vital precautionary safeguard alongside traditional McCrary-type tests.
